title: Computer Vision Engineer
summary: From image formation to CNNs, vision transformers and generative models. Start after Foundations.

stages.title: Deep Learning
stages.passCriteria: You can train an image or text model in PyTorch, explain each step, and explain how attention works.

stages.title: Classical Computer Vision
stages.passCriteria: You can explain image formation, edges, features, camera calibration and stereo.

stages.title: CNNs for Vision
stages.passCriteria: You can explain how a CNN sees an image and why residual connections help.

stages.title: Detection & Segmentation
stages.passCriteria: You can explain and implement object detection and semantic segmentation (Dive into Deep Learning, chapter 14).

stages.title: Transformers for Vision
stages.passCriteria: You can explain how ViT and CLIP apply attention to images.

stages.title: Generative Models (optional)
stages.passCriteria: You can explain how a diffusion model turns noise into an image.

stages.title: Portfolio Project
stages.passCriteria: You can fine-tune a detector on your own dataset, evaluate it per class with mAP, show where it fails, and deploy it behind an API.

stages.title: Interview Prep
stages.passCriteria: You can solve timed coding problems on data structures and algorithms, and answer ML knowledge and system design questions under time pressure.
